grh_873f959f7c76e329fa78.title: In Pursuit of a Ghost
paragraphs: In a Central American country on the edge of revolution, Harry is drawn into the hunt for a rebel leader who has escaped with about a million dollars. A beautiful woman later offers to help Harry steal the money from the fugitive in Havana and flee with it, but Harry recognizes the setup and warns the man instead, causing the woman to be arrested when she searches his hotel room. Harry then escorts the fugitive and the cash aboard his yacht, where government forces spring the real trap. The mild Englishman Harry met at the beginning reveals himself as the country's police captain and explains that he planted the clues Harry followed, using him to recover the citizens' money and draw the revolutionary leaders into the open. Harry is released with exactly the money he brought into the country, which is nothing.
